strings.zh: 尼比道馆的馆主小刚,{NEWLINE}虽说是以训练家为职业的,{CLEAR}但是他的人生梦想好像是{CLEAR}成为饲育家哟。{SCROLL}真是强大的人与温柔的心啊。
strings.en: Brock, the Pewter Gym Leader, may be a{NEWLINE}Trainer by trade, but his dream in life{CLEAR}is to become a Breeder.{SCROLL}Such strength, and such a gentle{NEWLINE}heart.

strings.zh: 胖丁『Buli,Buli！
strings.en: Jigglypuff: Buli, buli!

strings.zh: 听了胖丁的歌声后……{NEWLINE}人和精灵都会睡着。{SCROLL}如果胖丁在对战时唱歌,{NEWLINE}胖丁的训练家岂不是也要睡着了！
strings.en: When Jigglypuff sings, people and{NEWLINE}Pokémon alike fall asleep.{SCROLL}So if Jigglypuff sings in battle, won’t{NEWLINE}its Trainer fall asleep too?!

strings.zh: 啊啊……{NEWLINE}好想要大针蜂啊……{SCROLL}如果你有大针蜂的话{CLEAR}能不能和我的大岩蛇交换？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Ahh... I really want a Beedrill...{SCROLL}If you have a Beedrill,{NEWLINE}would you trade it for my Onix?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 太棒了！{SCROLL}多亏了你,{NEWLINE}我长久以来寻找的精灵{CLEAR}终于到手了！
strings.en: How wonderful! Thanks to you, I’ve{NEWLINE}finally got the Pokémon I’ve been{CLEAR}looking for all this time!
strings.notes: US 0463/4 | RV017: addition: dropped US 'You made my day!' not in the hack's zh

strings.zh: 我要的是大针蜂！{SCROLL}大针蜂哦哦哦……
strings.en: I want a Beedrill!{SCROLL}Beedrill, oh, oh, oh...
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position, flags page_breaks_lost

strings.zh: 如果有大针蜂,{NEWLINE}应该是不能拒绝交换的。{SCROLL}这就是说,你根本没有大针蜂啊。{CLEAR}啊啊,一定是那样……
strings.en: If you had a Beedrill, you wouldn’t turn{NEWLINE}down a trade.{SCROLL}So you just don’t have one, do you?{NEWLINE}Ahh, that must be it...

strings.zh: 和我交换的大岩蛇很帅吧？{SCROLL}怎么说都是帅气的我培育的嘛！
strings.en: Isn’t the Onix I traded you cool?{SCROLL}Of course it is. After all, cool old me{NEWLINE}raised it!

strings.zh: 如果你喜欢使用{NEWLINE}岩石系的口袋妖怪,{CLEAR}可以考虑组建一支沙暴队。{CLEAR}一方面沙暴天气可以伤害敌人,{CLEAR}另一方面岩石地面属性的精灵{CLEAR}还可以通过特性{CLEAR}获得天气效果加成。
strings.en: If you like using Rock-type Pokémon,{NEWLINE}think about building a sandstorm team.{SCROLL}A sandstorm damages your foes, and{NEWLINE}Rock- and Ground-type Pokémon can get{CLEAR}a boost from it through their Abilities.

strings.zh: 沙基拉『Saki！
strings.en: Pupitar: Saki!

strings.zh: 志霸『你好,{NEWLINE}我是精灵联盟四天王之一的志霸。
strings.en: Bruno: Greetings. I am Bruno, one of{NEWLINE}the Pokémon League’s Elite Four.

strings.zh: 志霸『哈哈,不必紧张。{SCROLL}因为我的精灵训练太辛苦了,{NEWLINE}所以就来拜托尼比市的馆主小刚{CLEAR}给他们做了一下康复按摩。{CLEAR}不得不说小刚的手法真不错啊,{CLEAR}如果饲育家界也有四天王的话,{CLEAR}我想他一定是其中之一。
strings.en: Bruno: Ha ha, there’s no need to be{NEWLINE}nervous.{SCROLL}My Pokémon’s training is grueling, so I{NEWLINE}asked Brock, Pewter City’s Gym Leader,{CLEAR}to give them a recovery massage.{SCROLL}I must say, Brock has quite the touch.{NEWLINE}If Breeders had an Elite Four, he’d{CLEAR}surely be one of them.

strings.zh: 艾比郎『Hitmon！
strings.en: Hitmonchan: Hitmon!

strings.zh: 是否要向志霸发起挑战？
strings.en: Challenge Bruno?

strings.zh: 志霸『哦？要向我挑战？{NEWLINE}嗯……{CLEAR}的确,我从你的身上能感受到{CLEAR}你对口袋妖怪的热情。{CLEAR}好的,我会认真应战的！
strings.en: Bruno: Oh? You wish to challenge me?{SCROLL}Hmm... Indeed, I can feel{NEWLINE}your passion for Pokémon.{CLEAR}Very well. I’ll face you in earnest!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 志霸『哈哈哈,真是长江后浪推前浪。{NEWLINE}以现在你的实力,足以胜任道馆馆主了！
strings.en: Bruno: Ha ha ha! Truly, the new{NEWLINE}generation surpasses the old. With your{CLEAR}skill, you could be a Gym Leader!

strings.zh: 志霸『哈哈哈,真是有毅力的训练家。{NEWLINE}我很看好你,努力变强吧！
strings.en: Bruno: Ha ha ha! What a determined{NEWLINE}Trainer. I have high hopes for you.{CLEAR}Keep getting stronger!

strings.zh: 我的小火龙真垃圾,{NEWLINE}面对岩系馆主毫无还手之力。{CLEAR}处理这种垃圾的最好方式{CLEAR}就是把它丢到路边{CLEAR}然后骗它我会回去找它,{CLEAR}让它在那里等我等到死,哈哈哈哈！
strings.en: My Charmander is garbage.{NEWLINE}It couldn’t do a thing against{CLEAR}the Rock-type Gym Leader.{SCROLL}The best way to deal with garbage like{NEWLINE}that is to dump it by the road...{SCROLL}...and trick it into thinking I’ll come{NEWLINE}back for it, so it waits there till it{CLEAR}dies. Ha ha ha ha!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 小火龙好像很喜欢你,{NEWLINE}想要和你一起去旅行。{CLEAR}要带上它吗？
strings.en: Charmander seems to like you a lot. It{NEWLINE}wants to go on a journey with you.{SCROLL}Take it with you?

strings.zh: 队伍已满,没有小火龙的位置了。
strings.en: Your party is full. There’s no room for{NEWLINE}Charmander.

strings.zh: 小火龙加入了队伍！
strings.en: Charmander joined your party!

strings.zh: 要给小火龙起昵称吗？
strings.en: Give Charmander a nickname?

strings.zh: 昵称叫{VAR:0101:1}{NEWLINE}可以吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Name it {VAR:0101:1}. Is that OK?{VAR:0200:0}
